Definition: from a compound of G5259 and a derivative of G5179; typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation:--form, pattern.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypotýpōsis carries the sense of a pattern, an outline, a model. In 1 Timothy 1:16, the text says "for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hypotýpōsis plainly — it means a pattern, an outline, a model, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
